βάζεις: βάζω — chatter, babble, talk; pres. 2 sg.
βίηφιν: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι(ν) (= dat. βίῃ): ’by force’
γεγάασι: γίγνομαι — be born, be; perf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic γεγόνασι): ’are born, are alive’
γηθόσυνος: γηθόσυνος — glad, joyful; masc. nom. sg., from γηθέω ’rejoice’
γνῶ: γιγνώσκω — recognise, know; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔγνω): ’recognised’
γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα); clasping the knees is the suppliant’s gesture
δήνεα: δῆνος — plan, wile, counsel (used only in the plural, epic and poetic); neut. acc. pl.
δόλοισι: δόλος — trick, stratagem, cunning device; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
εἴθ: εἴτε — whether, or; correlative conj., elided and aspirated (εἴθ’ = εἴτε) · also εἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (εἴθ’ = εἴθε; εἴθ’ … ἡβώοιμι ’would that I were in my prime’)
εἴρηται: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire; aor. subj. 3 sg. (epic, = Attic ἔρηται): ’he asks’
ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
κακοῖσι: κακός — bad, evil; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), used as a noun: ’ills, troubles’
κεφαλλήνων: Κεφαλλῆνες — the Cephallenians, Odysseus’ island people; masc. gen. pl.
κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
κυάνεαι: κυάνεος — dark, dark-blue; fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυαναῖ)
λάζετο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’took hold of’
λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
μελιηδέος: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελιηδοῦς)
μετέσσομαι: μέτειμι — be among (+ dat.); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic μετέσσομαι (stem ἐσσ-, = Attic μετέσομαι)
μεταμώνια: μεταμώνιος — wasted, vain, gone to the winds; neut. nom. pl.
μιγέντα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. (= μιγείς), + dat.: ’having mingled among’
μύθοισι: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
νέστορ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. voc. sg.
νεώτεροι: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’younger’
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πεζῶν: πεζός — on foot; used as a noun: ’foot-soldiers’; masc. gen. pl., gen. of what fills, after πλῆτο
περιώσιον: περιώσιος — beyond measure, excessive; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’exceedingly’
πολλήν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg.: ’much’ (φρόνιν … πολλήν ’much knowledge’)
ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’what a (word)’
πρώτοισιν: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
πυκιναὶ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; fem. nom. pl.
πύργος: πύργος — tower, city wall; masc. nom. sg.
σκοπιῆς: σκοπιή — watch-post, lookout point, height; fem. gen. sg.
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
στῆσεν: ἵστημι — set, make stand; aor. 3 sg., transitive, unaugmented (= ἔστησε): ’stopped, set down’
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
τείρει: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. 3 sg.
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε) · also neut. nom. pl., elided (φίλ’ = φίλα): ’dear’, predicate (τὰ φίλ’ ἔσκε ’were dear’)
φίλοισιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις); also as a noun: ’friends’
φρονέεις: φρονέω — think, have in mind, intend; pres. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονεῖς)
φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
φῂς: φημί — say, speak; pres. 2 sg. (= φῄς)
ἀνεμώλια: ἀνεμώλιος — windy, idle, vain (of words); neut. acc. pl.
ἐθέλοιμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 sg. (hypothetical wish)
ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘willing’
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
ἐπιμειδήσας: ἐπιμειδάω — smile at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’smiling’
ἐσθλοὺς: ἐσθλός — good, brave; masc. acc. pl.
ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν), used as an imperative: ’hold on!’ · also inf. as the wish after αἲ γάρ: ’(would that you) might have (my daughter)’ · also inf. of purpose: ’to have, to bear’
ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
ἑστάμεν: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. perf. stand; perf. inf. act., epic (= Attic ἑστάναι): ’to stand’
ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
ἔλασσεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἤλασε)
ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., predicate · also masc. nom. sg., predicate (νοῦς … ἔμπεδος ’the mind was steady’)
ἔτετμε: τέτμον (defective) — come upon, overtake; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’overtook’
ἕτερ: ἕτερος — other; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἕτερ’ = ἕτερα): ’others’
ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
ὀπάζει: ὀπάζω — bestow, grant, give as a follower; pres. 3 sg.
ὀτρυνέμεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, send forth; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ὀτρύνειν)
ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
ὁρμήσειε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, stir up (trans.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’(if) he should stir up’
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’ (ἄμμες ὄπισθεν ἀρεσσάμενοι ’we afterwards making amends’)
ὄψεαι: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὄψει)
ὑμείων: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; gen. pl., epic ὑμείων (= Attic ὑμῶν): ’of you’
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive (τοὺς δ’ ὧν ἐθέλει ’whomever he wishes’), not the possessive
